notes.title: Meet Birdly - The Li-bird-rarian! 🤘🐥🤘
notes.content:
Happy Monday, Kiddos! Grandma would like to introduce you to someone… 

Introducing Birdly - The Li-bird-rarian!

Can’t say “li-bird-rarian”? Neither can Grandma! But she doesn’t let that get in the way of making new friends 👵👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/3ca699690c3605368de7ceab8c17d1bea6bcc8de.gif

It’s been a while since we last introduced one of Grandma’s... lodgers. Last time, you met the Dust Bunny who’s been thriving inside her hand vac for years.

Thankfully, Birdly’s never had to experience the inside of the vacuum. She much prefers the open air - though when she’s been away too long, she starts acting a bit... odd. Maybe there’s something in the air that’s messing with her? Maybe it’s the smell of Grandma’s farts? Who knows!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/413932488e2956ffdd8b7e960760336ebbae2c36.gif

If you can ignore her vaguely ominous aura, Birdly is able to help out with some of Grandma’s tasks around the house - but you’ll have to play the game to see how that plays out 😌

Take a look at how far Birdly has come since our early concept art, below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/293568d25dc8949236d3140e30c9cdb98734c6ab.png

Birdly is brought to life by the amazingly talented Erin Pearce - who you may recognise from Yo Gabba Gabba!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/d998e8b5a9760d32cf92416fbb809807ccf96aec.png

We can’t wait for you to meet Birdly when Grandma, No! Launches later this year - wishlist us now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362680/Grandma_No/

notes.title: Meet the Dust Bunny 🐰💨
notes.content:
Hello, Deary 👵

Grandma was very excited to welcome you all into her home during Steam Next Fest and she hopes you and fun. The Wallride kiddos have been working very hard on the demo (which you can play now!). Here's one of the characters you can expect to meet beyond the demo.

Meet the Dust Bunny🐰💨 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/f21eb67d736ab18461972ddf10848e8d7f634b32.gif

Dust Bunny is a chill, sentient pile of dead skin cells that have been stuck and growing in Grandmaʼs hand vac for several years. Who would've thought a dust pile would be so interested in... books? Grandma doesn't have any lying around - so she'll need to figure out where to find one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/80f09537d58b6ff0da23f73ece2054c32a45a8d5.gif

The Dust Bunny has been part of Grandma's life for a very long time, an idea that was created early on in development and has stuck around since. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/1ad63298f31b8bcc136103a25f11c5fb90c13c94.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/ef7cb10ec108148f06d833e3b66dff65ee6af425.png

Dust Bunny is also voiced by our very own game director, Ty Burks! 🗣️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/59c292bf38f4c08a45404d328ff20b1177223ebd.png

Look out for the Dust Bunny in the full release of Grandma, No! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362680/Grandma_No/

notes.title: Grandma, No! - Steam Next Fest Demo now LIVE 👵

notes.title: Grandma, No! Dev Diary #1 - Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey, Kiddos! 👋
Hold onto your dentures! Grandma, No! is crashing the Steam Next Fest 👵💥
Yep, you read that right! Starting February 24th, you’ll get to live your wildest dreams and become Grandma! (We know, it’s weird. But in a fun way.)

And just to sweeten the deal, we’ve dropped our first Developer Diary on YouTube. It’s like a behind-the-scenes look at how Grandma was brought to life, with some extra sass from the devs. Go watch it before Grandma brings out the knitting needles!

Watch the full video here 👇
[previewyoutube=m9HnejB3iCw;full][/previewyoutube]

And give Grandma a wishlist, Deary (there's a hard-boiled candy in it for you 🍬)

notes.title: Grandma, No! - Game & Playtest Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Deary! 👵

Welcome to the Grandma, No! Steam Page. 

Step into Grandma's slippers in this hilarious, chaotic adventure where chores become challenges, and things always go... a little off-track. Can you keep things under control, or will the house turn into a whirlwind of chaos?

We're also holding a public playtest 🎮
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/c94861a4b2d9275af5182e63616e6fbfbd42c11c.png
Applications to are open right now, with the playtest taking place from 30th of Jan - 3rd of Feb.

You have to be a member of the discord in order to take part in the playtest, you can join here: https://discord.gg/jf4qMFZHBh

You have until the 29th of Jan to sign up. More information and sign ups here: https://forms.gle/4SDdcxikdTCEYCG68

Please give us a wishlist, Deary. It really means the world to Grandma! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362680/Grandma_No/
